name: DatePicker
description: A field with a calendar, a list of times, or both, behind a button inside it — type the value or pick it.

props.name: type
props.description: A day (`'date'`, default), a time of day (`'time'`), or both (`'datetime'`).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value, an ISO string of the picker's kind — see `DateField`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value it starts with when the picker owns its state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the value and its readings — `utc`, the reader's `local` wall clock, a `Date`.

props.name: zone
props.description: Whose wall clock a date-time is on. Default `'local'`; `'none'` for no zone at all.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: A 12- or 24-hour clock, in the field and the list of times. Default the locale's.

props.name: granularity
props.description: Whether a time is edited to the minute (default) or the second.

props.name: disambiguation
props.description: What a wall-clock time a zone skips or repeats means. Default `'compatible'`.

props.name: name
props.description: What the value posts under in a form.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between the times the list offers. Default 30.

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: The time a day picked before any time takes. Default `'00:00'`.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcuts beside the calendar — `{ label: 'Today', value: today() }`.

props.name: showZone
props.description: Whether a date-time names its zone after the time. Default: when the zone is not the reader's own.

props.name: locale
props.description: The language of the field, the calendar and the times. Default the reader's.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest value that is valid, and the first day the calendar offers.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Days nobody can choose.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not editable, not focusable and not openable.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable and read out, but not editable, and the button does not open.

props.name: required
props.description: The form is not valid until it is filled in — the browser's own check.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid whatever the bounds say. Default: invalid when out of bounds or unavailable.

props.name: label
props.description: The picker's visible name, above the field.

props.name: labelledBy
props.description: Names the field after an element already on the page, instead of `label`.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: An element that describes the field — a hint, an error.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the panel is open. Controlled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it starts open, when the picker owns that itself.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires with the new state and why — the layer's four reasons, and `'select'` when choosing closed it.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether choosing closes the panel. Default `true`; a date-time closes once its time is chosen.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The day the week starts on, 0 for Sunday. Default the locale's.

props.name: weekNumbers
props.description: ISO week numbers down the calendar's side.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the field the panel opens on. Default `'bottom'`.

props.name: align
props.description: Which of the field's edges it lines up with. Default `'start'`.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A button inside the field that empties it.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The calendar button's name. Default `'Choose date'`, or `'Choose time'`.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: The clear button's name. Default `'Clear'`.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Every segment's and button's tab index. Default `0`; `-1` keeps the picker out of the page's tab order, which a grid cell wants.

keyboard.action: On the button, opens the panel.
Closes it and returns focus to the button.
In the list of times, the time before or after.

a11y: The button says what it does and what is chosen — `Choose date, Oct 19, 2026` — and carries `aria-expanded` and `aria-haspopup="dialog"`; the panel is a `role="dialog"` named by the picker's label.
Opening puts focus on the chosen day (or today) in the calendar, or on the chosen time in the list.
